title: St. Augustine Parasail
specs: Flights launch in the morning when wind is calmest
Maximum combined weight per flight 450 lbs (captain determines safe pairings)
Pregnant guests not allowed to fly
No experience or swimming skills required
Waiver required for everyone boarding the boat
Group discounts available for 5 or more

blurb: Guests reserve parasailing flights launching from the City Marina dock at 111 Avenida Menendez St. Flights typically occur in the morning when winds are calm. Photo packages and observer seats are available.
extraNote: Weather cancellations allow reschedule or full refund · Group discount code for groups of 5 or more · Observer seats available by phone, not online, subject to availability · City Marina dock (111 Avenida Menendez St) · Limited winter schedule from October through February; sister operation in Daytona handles winter overflow

quotes.text: Five stars all around. Smooth and easy booking, exhilarating ride, and we even spotted dolphins from up there.
One of the highlights of the whole vacation. The crew was great with our kids and the views were unreal.
